newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble firm as demand ahead of T-bill sales seen.
newsitem.headline: Rouble firm as demand ahead of T-bill sales seen.

text.p: The rouble firmed in active trading on Tuesday on bank client and non-resident demand ahead of Wednesday's Treasury bill sales, dealers said.
On Wednesday, the finance ministry will offer four trillion roubles of 161-day GKO discount Treasury bills (series 22082) and 7.5 trillion roubles of 364-day T-bills (series 23006).
roubles/dollar May 6 midday May 6 early May 5 close
"Today (dollar) rates started to rise in the morning on expectations of a cheap roubles. But there was dollar selling afterwards, apparently, ahead of the auctions and rates fell," one dealer said.
